title: Menemen Turkish Scrambled Eggs
description: A Turkish-inspired scrambled eggs dish made with potatoes and spices. Quick, easy, and delicious, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: 1. Dice the potatoes and sauté them in a pan over medium heat until tender.
2. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Add zesty and smoky paprika to taste.
3. Add the whisked eggs to the pan with the potatoes. Scramble the eggs until they're cooked through.
4. Heat the menemen in a separate pan over low heat.
5. Serve the scrambled eggs on top of the menemen.
6. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
